summary: "Girlfriend" is the debut solo single by R&B singer Bobby Brown, released after he was expelled from the group New Edition. It was taken from his first album, "King of Stage", which did not chart. The single reached number one on the R&B charts for two weeks and peaked at fifty-seven on the Hot 100.
one_line: "Girlfriend" is Bobby Brown's 1986-era debut solo single, taken from the album King of Stage, which topped the R&B charts.
key_facts: "Girlfriend" is the debut solo single by R&B singer Bobby Brown.
Bobby Brown was thrown out of the R&B/pop group New Edition before releasing the single.
Brown's first album was titled "King of Stage".
The single was taken from the album "King of Stage".
The album "King of Stage" failed to break the charts.
"Girlfriend" went to number one on the R&B charts for two weeks.
"Girlfriend" peaked at fifty-seven on the Hot 100.
Bobby Brown was previously a member of New Edition, an R&B/pop group.
